summary: Card C01104-K2 was flagged when transaction 3459158 ($149.92) generated a calibrated fraud model score of 0.998. Investigation identified an 18-minute burst of four online purchases totaling $600.10 for product H on 2016-11-15, each utilizing device D007387 across four different billing regions. Device D007387 was new to this account and directly linked the card to compromised card C02354-K2 operating behind a proxy, while card C01104-K2 also has six prior confirmed fraud cases. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device with 0.97 probability. The card was blocked and a regulatory report was filed.
open_question: While the rapid burst sequence, device telemetry, and cross-card proxy links confirm card-not-present fraud from a new device, it remains uncertain whether cardholder C01104 has reported the unauthorized activity. Customer outreach will confirm whether any additional transactions were compromised before completing the block and reissue process.
